name: Expdb.EulerMaclaurin.sum_Icc_eq_integral_add
statement:
theorem sum_Icc_eq_integral_add [CompleteSpace E]
    (fc : ContDiffOn ℝ (s + 1) f t) (u : UniqueDiffOn ℝ t)
    (abt : Icc (a : ℝ) (a + n) ⊆ t) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc a (a + n), f k =
      (∫ x in a..a + n, f x) +
      (2⁻¹ : ℝ) • (f a + f (a + n)) +
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range s, (-1 : ℝ) ^ m • saw (m + 2) 0 •
        (iteratedDerivWithin (m + 1) f t (a + n) - iteratedDerivWithin (m + 1) f t a) +
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ s •
        ∫ x in a..a + n, saw (s + 1) x • iteratedDerivWithin (s + 1) f t x

name: Expdb.exponentialSumAt_dilate
statement:
lemma exponentialSumAt_dilate (F : ℝ → ℝ) (T N : ℝ) (a b q : ℕ) [NeZero q]
    (hq : 0 < q) (hT : T ≠ 0) (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    exponentialSumAt F T N a b =
      (q : ℂ)⁻¹ * ∑ h : ZMod q,
        exponentialSumAt (fun u ↦ F u + (h.val : ℝ) * N / T * u)
          T (q * N) (q * a) (q * b)

name: Expdb.exponentialSumAt_residue
statement:
lemma exponentialSumAt_residue (F : ℝ → ℝ) (T N : ℝ) (a b q r : ℕ)
    (hq : 0 < q) (hr : r < q) (hra : r ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hN : N ≠ 0) (hrN : (r : ℝ) < N) :
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc a b with n % q = r, oscillatory F T N n) =
      exponentialSumAt (residuePhase F N r) T (residueScale N q r)
        ((a - r) ⌈/⌉ q) ((b - r) / q)

name: Expdb.norm_exponentialSumAt_dilate_le

lemma norm_exponentialSumAt_dilate_le (F : ℝ → ℝ) (T N : ℝ) (a b q : ℕ)
    [NeZero q]
    (hq : 0 < q) (hT : T ≠ 0) (hN : N ≠ 0) :
    ‖exponentialSumAt F T N a b‖ ≤
      ∑ h : ZMod q,
        ‖exponentialSumAt (fun u ↦ F u + (h.val : ℝ) * N / T * u)
          T (q * N) (q * a) (q * b)‖ / q

theorem l2_integral_estimate :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a : ι → ℂ) (ξ : ι → ℝ) (N : ℝ),
    0 < N →
    IsSeparatedFamily (1 / N) ξ →
    ∀ left right T : ℝ,
    T = right - left →
    left ≤ right →
    ∃ θ : ℝ, |θ| ≤ C ∧
    ∫ t in Set.Icc left right,
      ‖∑ r, a r * 𝐞 (ξ r * t)‖ ^ 2 =
    (T + θ * N) * ∑ r, ‖a r‖ ^ 2

theorem l2_integral_estimate_error :

    ∀ left right T : ℝ,
    T = right - left →
    left ≤ right →
    |(∫ t in Set.Icc left right, ‖∑ r, a r * 𝐞 (ξ r * t)‖ ^ 2) -
        T * ∑ r, ‖a r‖ ^ 2| ≤
      C * N * ∑ r, ‖a r‖ ^ 2

name: Expdb.l2_integral_estimate_exists_norm_sq_ge
statement:
theorem l2_integral_estimate_exists_norm_sq_ge :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
    ∀ {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a : ι → ℂ) (ξ : ι → ℝ) (N : ℝ),
    0 < N →
    IsSeparatedFamily (1 / N) ξ →
    ∀ left right : ℝ,
    2 * C * N ≤ right - left →
    ∃ t ∈ Set.Icc left right,
      (∑ r, ‖a r‖ ^ 2) / 2 ≤ ‖∑ r, a r * 𝐞 (ξ r * t)‖ ^ 2
